ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, UBOs, shareholders, signatories and counterparties against the OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated Sanctions Lists, UK Treasury Sanctions List, EU Asset-Freeze List, Gibraltar Sanctions List, and national PEP databases; risk-based enhanced due diligence for PEPs using source of wealth and source of funds verification, adverse media checks, and ongoing transaction monitoring per FATF Recommendations and Gibraltar/Bermuda AML/CFT regulations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Gibraltar Companies Registry (official registry portal: www.gibraltar.gov.gi/companies-registry; online service through the Gibraltar e-Registry portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official language is English; corporate names must be rendered in the Latin (Roman) alphabet only. Names using non-Latin characters, diacritics or foreign scripts are not accepted. The name must be distinguishable from existing registered names and not misleading in Gibraltar or Bermuda.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a rejection notice, the applicant may file a written appeal with the Gibraltar Registrar of Companies within 14 calendar days, attaching statutory grounds, references to the Companies Act, and supporting evidence. The Registrar must determine the appeal within a further 21 days. If the appeal is refused, the applicant may seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Gibraltar or, for a Bermuda parent, re-submit under a fresh name application after the 30-day reservation window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a statutory registered office. The Bermuda exempted company must maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda through a licensed registered agent; a Gibraltar-registered foreign company must maintain a registered office in Gibraltar. A virtual office may be used solely as a correspondence and mailing address in support of the consulting business, but cannot satisfy the statutory physical-office requirement under either Bermuda's Companies Act 1981 or Gibraltar's Companies Act 2014.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 18% for a standard non-regulated MedTech consultancy with no licences; 32% if the entity maintains a Gibraltar branch, appoints Gibraltar resident directors/officers, or opens a local bank account; under 8% for a purely advisory presence with no physical staff in either Bermuda or Gibraltar.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 (Cap. 100), ss. 3, 10-24; Companies (Fees) Regulations 2016; Income Tax Act 2010 (exempt status confirmation)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Gibraltar Companies House - Registry of Companies, Suite 771, Europort, Gibraltar
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 (Application for Registration) together with Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum issued or paid-up capital applies to a private company limited by shares; incorporation may be effected with nil or GBP 1 issued capital. Where cash subscriptions are made prior to registration, the monies must be held in escrow and released only upon issue of the Certificate of Incorporation (Companies Act 2014, s. 65).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company be incorporated under the Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 and that the subscribers shall execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association. RESOLVED, that the initial issued share capital of GBP 1,000, comprising 1,000 ordinary shares of GBP 1.00, be allotted, subscribed and paid into escrow pending registration. RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at Suite X, Europort, Gibraltar, and the Registrar be notified. RESOLVED, that [Name] and [Name] be appointed first Directors, and [Name] be appointed Company Secretary. RESOLVED, that the Directors be authorized to open bank accounts, effect filings, and take all necessary actions to complete incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House - Registry of Companies (e-Registry online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search the public register for identical or confusingly similar names; reserve the proposed name via the e-Registry portal. The name must end in 'Limited' or 'Ltd', must not be offensive, and must not imply government patronage. Obtain written consent of the proposed registered office owner for the name reservation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file a fresh name application or appeal to the Registrar within 21 days under Companies Act 2014, s. 11.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public or licensed formation agent; submission to Gibraltar Companies House
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, setting out the company name, objects, share structure, and internal governance rules. Each subscriber must sign in the presence of a witness; corporate subscribers execute through a duly authorized signatory under power of attorney.
required_dossiers: Statement of Capital and Initial Shareholdings
Statement of Compliance (Form 3) signed by a subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amend the defective document, re-execute with fresh witness signatures, and resubmit with a covering letter explaining the changes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application and statutory fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Gibraltar Companies House (e-Registry online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 1 (Application for Registration), Form 2 (Particulars of Directors, Secretary and Registered Office), Form 3 (Statement of Compliance), Statement of Capital, and the executed Memorandum and Articles. Pay the statutory registration fee by card or bank transfer and upload escrow confirmation where shares are paid in cash.
required_dossiers: Form 2 - Particulars of Directors, Secretary and Registered Office
Statement of Capital and Initial Shareholdings
Escrow deposit confirmation (if capital is cash-subscribed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The Registrar will issue a notice of defect; rectify the defects and refile within 14 days. Failure to do so may result in rejection and fee refund (Companies Act 2014, s. 23).

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House - Registry of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon confirmation of compliance, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the unique company number, registers the constitutional documents, and publishes the company's details. Obtain certified copies of the certificate for escrow release, tax registration, and bank onboarding.
required_dossiers: Registered Memorandum and Articles of Association
Copy of registered directors and secretary filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If clerical errors appear on the certificate, file a corrected application with Companies House within 7 days for re-issue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board meeting and adoption of corporate governance instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Company Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting; adopt the First Board Resolution approving share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. Issue share certificates, approve the company seal (if any), open statutory registers, and authorize the opening of a corporate bank account with the selected EMI or bank.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
Bank account opening pack (certified directors' passports and proof of address)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If statutory records are defective, redraft minutes and resolutions and hold a ratification meeting to validate the appointments and allotments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax status confirmation and regulatory clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: HM Government of Gibraltar - Income Tax Office / Revenue Commissioner; Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (only if regulated activity engaged)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to the Income Tax Office for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and confirm the entity's tax-exempt status in respect of non-Gibraltar-source income. Verify that the MedTech regulatory consulting activity (ISIC 7490/NAICS 541690) requires no sectoral license in Gibraltar, and register as an employer for payroll and social insurance if local staff are hired.
required_dossiers: Directors' and beneficial owners' identification documents (passport, proof of address)
Business description and activity confirmation letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to Revenue Commissioner queries within 30 days; if tax status is contested, file an objection under the Income Tax Act 2010 and request a statutory review.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - the business is professional consulting (ISIC 7490 / NAICS 541690) and is not subject to industrial licensing in Gibraltar.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - no manufacturing or operational permit is required for MedTech regulatory consulting; the operative authorization is the Certificate of Incorporation.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: HM Government of Gibraltar - Department of the Environment, Heritage and Climate Change (DEHCC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - not listed under the Environmental Impact Assessment and Habitats Regulations; no EIA report required for office-based professional services.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No discharge thresholds apply for office-only activities; if IT hardware is deployed, waste must be managed under the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) Regulations as applied in Gibraltar, and any air-conditioning/refrigerant equipment must comply with the Ozone-Depleting Substances and F-Gas Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for an office-based consultancy. If a physical office is leased, the landlord must maintain up-to-date fire risk assessment and building safety certificates, and the company must complete a general workplace safety statement under the Health and Safety at Work Act (Gibraltar) before staff occupy the premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Gibraltar: Income Tax Office (Commissioner of Income Tax), H.M. Government of Gibraltar — official portal via www.gibraltar.gov.gi; Companies House Gibraltar for entity registration. Bermuda: Office of the Registrar of Companies, H.M. Government of Bermuda (www.gov.bm). UK HMRC (www.gov.uk/hmrc) relevant only where UK VAT registration arises.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Bermuda Exempted Company obtains (a) a Bermuda registration number and Certificate of Exempted Status from the Bermuda Registrar of Companies — no income-tax TIN is issued in Bermuda because exempted companies are tax-exempt, and the annual government-fee receipt and Tax Assurance Certificate constitute the tax identity; and (b) where managed-and-controlled in Gibraltar or maintaining a Gibraltar branch, a Gibraltar Tax Reference Number via the tax registration form filed with the Gibraltar Income Tax Office, accompanied by certified Bermuda incorporation documents, a Gibraltar registered office, local officer details and any applicable Economic Substance Form ESD. TIN issuance normally takes 5-10 working days. If UK taxable supplies arise, Form VAT1 to HMRC issues a UK VAT number and MTD-compatible software is required. Bermuda Corporate Income Tax registration applies only if the entity is a constituent entity of an MNE group with consolidated revenue of EUR 750 million or more under the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (Bermuda exempted-company statutory tax protection under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966; exempted from Bermuda income and capital gains tax; Gibraltar territorial taxation applies only to Gibraltar-source profits or profits attributable to a Gibraltar permanent establishment; no US-LLC-type pass-through).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: (i) Bermuda exempted undertaking election and Tax Assurance Certificate under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966; (ii) Gibraltar non-residence determination through documented management-and-control outside Gibraltar to confine taxation to Gibraltar-source income; (iii) US Form 8832 check-the-box election relevant to FDA 510(k) contractor payments, subject to per-se corporation analysis; (iv) Gibraltar anti-hybrid and OECD BEPS Action 2 compliant filings to prevent deduction/no-inclusion outcomes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Gibraltar Purchase Tax — selective single-stage consumption tax on importation of goods and specified supplies; no VAT or GST in Gibraltar or Bermuda; UK VAT applies only to taxable transactions supplied in the United Kingdom
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: GIP 0 — Gibraltar Purchase Tax has no turnover-based registration threshold; any importation of dutiable goods into Gibraltar triggers the duty irrespective of turnover. UK VAT registration threshold is currently GBP 90,000 taxable turnover, with deregistration at GBP 88,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None in Gibraltar or Bermuda. There is no continuous transaction control, no real-time fiscal clearance API, and no mandatory digital stamping or QR coding of invoices. The Gibraltar Income Tax Office accepts ordinary commercial invoices. If UK VAT applies, HMRC Making Tax Digital requires digital record-keeping and functional-compatible software for VAT returns, but there is no real-time HMRC invoice clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Gibraltar does not levy VAT or GST and therefore has no export zero-rating mechanism; exports of goods from Gibraltar are outside the scope of Purchase Tax upon evidence of physical departure. For a UK-VAT-registered entity, goods exported from the UK to a third country are zero-rated at 0% under VATA 1994 s.30 provided export occurs within 3 months of supply. FDA 510(k) and CE-marking B2B consultancy services supplied to non-UK business customers are outside the scope of UK VAT, with the customer applying the reverse charge; input VAT on UK and Gibraltar business costs remains recoverable where the entity holds UK VAT registration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration — UK Customs Declaration Service (CDS) or Gibraltar Single Administrative Document (SAD) evidencing physical export
Commercial invoice and packing list describing the exported goods and linking them to the FDA 510(k) / CE Mark consultancy service deliverables
Bill of Lading (sea) or Air Waybill (air) proving the goods left the customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 or bank statement evidencing receipt of export proceeds from the foreign buyer
Underlying export contract, purchase order and FDA/CE regulatory engagement agreement connecting the service to the exported goods
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Gibraltar and UK authorities rigorously audit export evidence and refund claims. Fraudulent zero-rating or export claims attract criminal sanctions under UK CEMA 1979 s.170 — unlimited fine and imprisonment up to 7 years — and civil penalties under FA 2007 Schedule 24 (30%-100% of tax lost) plus interest. Gibraltar Customs Ordinance penalties include forfeiture of goods, treble-value penalties and criminal fines for false declarations. Retrospective clawback of claimed 0% rates and input VAT is enforced where export evidence is missing, forged, or the goods are diverted; documentary retention of at least 6 years is mandatory.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as banking and fiduciary supervisor, with the Commissioner of Currency (Government of Gibraltar) acting as the note-issuing and currency authority; monetary framework is pegged to the Bank of England's sterling policy.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Gibraltar pound (GIP) is fully convertible into sterling at a fixed 1:1 parity, and no exchange controls apply to current account or capital account transactions. Profit remittance is unrestricted for non-resident shareholders and no prior authorization is required; however, corporate transfers must comply with the Gibraltar Companies Act record-keeping, beneficial ownership registry disclosure, and anti-money laundering verification standards.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Gibraltar imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline for export receipts. Medical device regulatory consulting fees may be retained in any freely convertible currency, subject only to the firm's own treasury liquidity management and tax filing obligations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Operational Account (inbound/outbound settlement) and Interest-bearing Escrow
Operational Account and Offshore Capital Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium under the post-Brexit framework. An offshore digital EMI (outside the UK or EEA) cannot rely on Gibraltar passporting rights and must obtain a separate e-money authorization from the GFSC if it solicits Gibraltar-licensed banking clients. Holding operational liquidity in an unauthorized EMI may breach GFSC safeguarding expectations and deprive the account holder of any deposit compensation coverage.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Gibraltar regulated banks do not impose a universal physical attendance mandate. Remote corporate onboarding is available through qualified video identification and notarized corporate documents, but the ultimate beneficial owners and the compliance officer must normally attend a recorded interview. For a Bermuda Exempted Company with offshore directors, banks may require at least one natural person to appear in person at the Gibraltar registered office or at a British consulate; digital-only onboarding is accepted only where all key parties hold valid EU/UK passports and produce a clean public-profile background.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bermuda Exempted Company is a tax-exempt offshore entity with no physical presence in Gibraltar immediately except a mailbox address; bank flags shell-company pattern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the valid Bermuda certificate of exemption, current certificate of incorporation, a board resolution appointing an actual Gibraltar-resident compliance officer, a full AEOI/CRS classification, an executed consultancy services agreement with named medical device principals, a substance business plan detailing the revenue model, and annual account projections exceeding the bank's minimum revenue substance threshold.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: True ultimate beneficial owners cannot be identified due to nominee equity sharing or bearer-share historical records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the individuals-backed beneficial ownership register filed with the Bermuda registry, a notarized nominee disclosure, sworn declarations from each shareholder, and a legal opinion from a qualified Bermuda/Gibraltar counsel confirming that no bearer instruments exist and that all transfers into the Gibraltar account are exclusively for lawful MedTech consulting purposes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or working capital is routed as a SWIFT MT103 wire to the entity's Gibraltar bank account (GIP or GBP), citing purpose code 'General operating expenses for professional services' or 'Capital injection of a non-resident corporate shareholder.' The bank verifies the corporate name, the Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) registry listing, and the economic substance of the transaction. Any amount above the bank's internal threshold must be accompanied by a capital injection resolution, evidence of foreign exchange conversion via the bank's spot desk, and a detailed breakdown of the shareholder loan or equity account. For US-origin funds relating to the FDA 510(k) work, the transfer protocol must provide an SOF declaration and the IRS Form Form 926/8858 excerpt when applicable.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlements for clinical/research contracts, subcontractor fees, and CE mark consultancy invoices are cleared over SWIFT MT103/MT202 with CHAPS for GBP, or via the bank's real-time gross settlement (RTGS) if the creditor maintains a Gibraltar clearing account. Commercial Letters of Credit are permitted only for physical FDA/CE prototype production and analytical laboratory consumables; these facilities are issued on an unconfirmed basis unless the bank holds cash cover. All outgoing wires must cite the relevant BPM6 service code (i.e., '249' for regulatory consultancy) and the invoice ID; the receiving bank will require an officer-completed transaction attestation for service imports.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forwards against GIP/GBP parity forward with a max tenor of 18 months
FX swaps between GIP and EUR/USD for working capital conversion
European-type FX options for contingency cost management
Non-deliverable forwards are not permissible for EUR/USD hedging where the Gibraltarian bank can provide an onshore deliverable contract; exceptions require documented offshore limitation
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for refinancing multi-currency capital loans

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bermuda Annual Return for Exempted Company (Form AR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation plus 30 calendar days, and not later than 31 July in each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late fee of USD 250; after 3 months of non-payment the Registrar may issue a strike-off notice and dissolve the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Gibraltar Overseas Company Annual Return and Accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the anniversary of the company's registration as an overseas company in Gibraltar, using the Bermuda accounting period end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic late penalty of GBP 100 (approx. USD 125) and a daily fine of GBP 10; prolonged default may result in cancellation from the Register of Overseas Companies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the Gibraltar Annual Return; the PSC register must be updated within 14 days of any share transfer and the confirmation must be certified no more than 12 months prior
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to GBP 500 per offence and a daily default fine of GBP 50; non-compliance is referred to the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Economic Substance Unit, Ministry of Finance, Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of each financial year; for a 31 December year-end, the filing is due by 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of up to BMD 100,000 for the first contravention and BMD 200,000 for further contraventions, plus possible strike-off and loss of Bermuda tax exemption status.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Audit is compulsory for Bermuda Exempted Companies holding a regulated licence (banking, insurance, investment, trust) or where shareholders holding at least 10% of shares request an audit; otherwise audit is voluntary but recommended if the entity has annual turnover above BMD 5 million, assets above BMD 2.5 million, or 50 or more employees.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS is mandatory for regulated entities; non-regulated Bermuda Exempted Companies may apply IFRS, UK GAAP, US GAAP, or generally accepted accounting principles permissible under Bermuda law.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must maintain a register of persons with significant control (PSC) and, in Gibraltar, file an annual confirmation simultaneously with the annual return. In Bermuda, the annual return serves as the annual confirmation of the beneficial ownership register, and any share transfers must be recorded in the Register of Members within 21 days and reflected in the PSC register within 14 days. A director or company secretary must certify the accuracy of the annual confirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 2,000 - USD 4,000 (Bermuda registered office and resident agent) plus USD 500 - USD 1,000 for Gibraltar agent facilities
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 - USD 12,000 for a fully certified statutory audit; USD 2,500 - USD 5,000 for a limited review or unaudited compliance engagement

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
